header.intro: We care about the privacy of everyone who visits our website. Below we explain what data we collect, for what purpose and on what legal basis we process it, with whom we may share it, and what rights you have.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is ENTEI Sebastian Jarmul — a sole proprietorship with its registered office at ul. Wojska Polskiego 24/13, 37-450 Stalowa Wola, Poland, Tax ID (NIP) 8652574151 (hereinafter: “ENTEI”, “we” or the “Controller”).
For all matters related to the processing of personal data and the exercise of your rights, you can contact us at: hello@entei.design.
This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use and protect the data of people who visit the entei.design website and contact us, including via Instagram.

sections.title: 2. Definitions and legal basis
paragraphs: We process personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data (the “GDPR”) and the Polish Personal Data Protection Act of 10 May 2018.
For the purposes of this Policy, the following terms have the meanings below:
bullets: Personal data — any information that allows a natural person to be identified, such as a name, email address or IP address.
Processing — any operation performed on personal data, e.g. collection, storage, use or deletion.
Cookies — small text files saved on your device while you use the website.
User — any person visiting the entei.design website or contacting ENTEI.

sections.title: 3. What data we collect and from where
paragraphs: The scope of the data we collect depends on how you use the website and contact us.

Contact form data — when you fill in the contact form available on the website, you provide us with your name, email address, optionally a company name and the content of your message. Providing this data is voluntary but necessary for us to respond to your enquiry.

Service order data: when you order a service online, you give us your name, email address, phone number and, if you want a company invoice, the company name, VAT ID and address. Providing this data is voluntary but necessary to conclude and perform the contract and issue an invoice.

Data from contact via Instagram — if you contact us through our Instagram profile (@entei.designs), via direct messages or comments, we process your profile name and the content of the correspondence along with any information you choose to share with us.

Technical and analytics data — while you browse the website, data such as your IP address, browser type and version, device type, operating system, approximate geographic location, traffic source and information about your activity on the site are collected automatically. This data is collected using cookies and the tools described in section 5.

sections.title: 4. Purposes and legal bases of processing
paragraphs: We process your personal data for the following purposes and on the following legal bases:
bullets: Concluding and performing the contract for services ordered online, including handling payments and complaints: art. 6(1)(b) GDPR; issuing invoices and keeping accounting records: legal obligation (art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

Handling enquiries from the contact form and conducting correspondence — taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in communicating with people interested in our services (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Contact and handling correspondence via Instagram — our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries made through social media (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Website analytics and audience statistics — your voluntary consent given through the cookie banner (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
Marketing, including remarketing and measuring the effectiveness of ads on Meta and Google — your voluntary consent given through the cookie banner (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
Establishing, pursuing or defending against claims — our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: 5. Cookies and tracking technologies
paragraphs: The entei.design website uses cookies and similar technologies. Cookies necessary for the website to function properly are always saved and do not require consent. Analytics and marketing cookies are saved only after you give consent in the cookie banner.
The table below lists the external tools and technologies used on the website:

rows: Remarketing and measuring the effectiveness of advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram
Managing tags and analytics scripts on the website
Measuring conversions and the effectiveness of Google advertising campaigns
Analytics of traffic, sessions and user behaviour on the website, including approximate geolocation
Anonymous performance and traffic analytics, operating without cookies
Delivering and correctly displaying fonts on the website

sections.title: 6. Managing cookie consent
paragraphs: On your first visit, we display a cookie banner where you can consent to analytics and marketing cookies (“Accept”) or decline them (“Necessary only”). Until consent is given, we do not activate any analytics or marketing tools.

You can withdraw your consent at any time. To do so, use the “Manage cookies” option available in the website footer — this will display the banner again and let you change your choice. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before its withdrawal.

Regardless of the banner, you can manage cookies directly in your web browser settings — including deleting saved files and blocking them from being saved. Restricting cookies may affect the operation of certain website features.

sections.title: 7. Data recipients and processors
paragraphs: In connection with operating the website and handling enquiries, your data may be transferred to trusted entities that process it on our behalf or as independent controllers. These include:
bullets: Resend — the email delivery service provider through which correspondence related to the contact form is handled.
Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. — in connection with the Meta Pixel tool and contact via Instagram.
Google Ireland Ltd. — in connection with the Google Tag Manager and Google Ads tools.
Travatar — the analytics tool provider.
Vercel Inc. — the provider of website hosting and the Vercel Analytics service.
Calendly LLC — in connection with booking consultation appointments, if you choose to use this form of contact.
Adobe Systems Inc. — in connection with delivering the fonts displayed on the website.
PayU S.A., Poznań (ul. Grunwaldzka 186, 60-166 Poznań): we share order data with it to process online payments; PayU S.A. is a separate controller for payment processing.

sections.title: 8. Transfers of data outside the EEA
paragraphs: Some of the data recipients listed in section 7 — in particular the providers of Meta, Google, Vercel, Resend, Calendly and Adobe tools — are based or process data outside the European Economic Area (EEA), mainly in the United States.

Transfers of data to third countries take place with the appropriate safeguards required by the GDPR — based on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission or under the Data Privacy Framework, which providers with the relevant certification have joined.

sections.title: 9. Data retention period
paragraphs: We store your personal data for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected:
bullets: Contact form data and correspondence — for the time necessary to handle the enquiry and then until the limitation period for any claims expires.
Data processed based on consent (analytics, marketing) — until consent is withdrawn or the cookies expire, in line with the periods indicated in section 5.
Data processed based on legitimate interest — until an effective objection is raised or that interest ceases to apply.
Order and invoice data: for the duration of the contract, then for 5 years from the end of the tax year (tax obligations) or until claims become time-barred.

sections.title: 10. Your rights
paragraphs: In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the following rights:
bullets: the right to access your data and to receive a copy of it,
the right to rectification of incorrect or outdated data,
the right to erasure of data (the “right to be forgotten”),
the right to restriction of processing,
the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest,
the right to data portability,
the right to withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before its withdrawal,
the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority — the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland).

sections.title: 11. Exercising your rights and contact
paragraphs: To exercise your rights, contact us at: hello@entei.design. We will respond to your request without undue delay, no later than within one month of receiving it.
Where necessary — for example due to the complexity of the request — this period may be extended by a further two months, and you will be informed accordingly.

sections.title: 12. Profiling and automated decisions
paragraphs: Within the Meta and Google marketing tools, your data may be used for profiling, which consists of tailoring the ads displayed to your interests and online activity (remarketing).

This profiling takes place solely on the basis of your consent and does not produce legal effects concerning you nor similarly significantly affect you. You can withdraw your consent at any time using the “Manage cookies” option in the website footer.

sections.title: 13. Data security
paragraphs: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction or disclosure. The connection to the website is encrypted using the SSL protocol.
Access to the data is granted only to people and entities for whom it is necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Policy.

sections.title: 14. Data of minors
paragraphs: The entei.design website and the services we provide are not directed at persons under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data of children. If you find that you have provided us with the data of a minor, please contact us — we will delete it immediately.

sections.title: 15. Links to external websites
paragraphs: The website may contain links to external services such as Instagram, Behance or Calendly, as well as to our clients' websites. We are not responsible for the privacy policies and data processing practices applicable on those services.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies in force on the websites you visit via the links we provide.

sections.title: 16. Changes to the privacy policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically, in particular in the event of changes in the law, the introduction of new tools or changes to the scope of services provided.
The current version of the Policy is always available on this page, and the date of the last update is indicated at the top of the document. This Privacy Policy is effective as of 22 May 2026.

hatan.title: Hatan
hatan.intro: Hatan is an electronic music project and DJ duo from Wrocław, built on the raw energy of rave culture and the brutalist concrete of the city's „Manhattan” estate. The brand needed an identity as bold and uncompromising as its sound, one that could carry a growing community across stages, screens and the street.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: We built Hatan as a complete brand world where industrial design meets electronic music. From a single architectural idea we defined a full visual and verbal system: logo, color, typography, iconography and a graphic language that turns a DJ duo into a recognizable cultural brand, ready to scale from local raves to a global audience.

challenge.heading: Challenge
challenge.body: Electronic music brands tend to blur into the same neon gradients and generic club aesthetics. Hatan needed to stand apart and feel like a movement, not just a logo, while staying flexible enough to live across posters, merch, social media and live visuals. The task was to translate an intangible feeling (bass, concrete and freedom) into a system anyone could apply consistently.

conceptBody.heading: Creative concept
conceptBody.body: The whole identity grows from one place: the brutalist „Manhattan” estate in Wrocław. The brandmark fuses the letter H into a geometric concrete block built on a spherical grid, radiating the heavy bass that defines Hatan's sound. A deep „Velvet Beat” maroon and full black set a premium, nocturnal tone, accented by „Pulse Ember” red, while Drummer, a futuristic display face, pairs with the functional Standerd grotesk. A „Sedes” pattern drawn from the estate's facades ties every surface back to the architecture.

results.heading: Result
results.body: The result is a cohesive, uncompromising identity that gives Hatan the presence of an established label rather than an emerging duo. A flexible system of logos, gradients, patterns and templates lets the brand produce striking posters, merch and social content fast, while keeping a single, unmistakable voice across every channel.

quote.concept: An identity poured in concrete: the raw weight of brutalist architecture meeting the pulse of electronic bass.
quote.style: Bold type, 3D wireframes and industrial texture: every touchpoint feels like a structure you can hear.

Positioning built on brutalist architecture, raw energy and community

Logo system: brandmark, wordmark, horizontal, vertical and favicon variants

Custom iconography built on an 18×18 spherical grid

Brand applied to social media, posters, event materials, documents and merch
Brand guidelines document codifying the full system

artMat.title: Art-Mat
artMat.intro: Art-Mat is a tire service and sales company in Stalowa Wola, Poland, trusted by individual drivers and fleet owners alike. As the business grew, its old image no longer matched the professionalism and modern service it delivers every day.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: We built Art-Mat's brand to convey trust, safety and technical confidence while signaling a modern, premium service. We defined a complete visual and verbal system, from logo to website, that positions Art-Mat as the local market leader rather than just another tire shop.

challenge.heading: Challenge
challenge.body: The main challenge was standing out against chains like Best Drive and First Stop, which dominate the category with aggressive reds and price-led messaging. We analyzed the competition and the needs of three core audiences (local drivers, truck and fleet owners, and younger customers expecting a modern booking experience) and found a position no one owned: a trusted, premium local partner.

concept.heading: Creative concept
concept.body: The whole identity grows from one idea, the tire. The mark fuses the letters A and M into a geometric, tire-inspired form, while a stripe pattern used in sequence builds a tread and tire track. A premium palette of gold, grey and deep black replaces the category's usual red, signaling quality over discount. Northura for display and Switzer for text complete its technical, confident character.

results.heading: Result
results.body: The result is a cohesive, premium identity that elevates how Art-Mat is perceived by drivers, fleet partners and the local community, and a system flexible enough to grow with the business across new services and locations.

quote.promise: Art-Mat doesn't just change tires. It looks after your safety on the road, every single day.
quote.gold: A gold-led identity that trades the usual discount red for trust, precision and premium care.

scope.heading: Project details
items: Complete rebrand of a Stalowa Wola tire service with regional reach
Positioning built on trust, safety and premium local service
Combination mark fusing the letters A and M into a tire-inspired brandmark
Gold, grey and deep-black palette that differentiates from red-led competitors

remMet.title: REM-MET
remMet.intro: REM-MET is a company with over 20 years of experience in welding, facing the challenge of entering a new market. The owner wanted to expand into manufacturing safety guarding for industrial machinery, products that would not only meet standards but build customer trust through solidity and bespoke fit.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: Our task was to create a new visual identity and website that would clearly present the new product lines and position REM-MET as a professional partner for industry, ready to take work off the client's hands at every stage of a project.

challenge.heading: Challenge
challenge.body: Entering the safety-guarding market meant standing out from manufacturers who mostly rely on red, orange and yellow. We had to connect the company's 20-year welding heritage with a new industrial direction and structure the offer so it would be easy to remember and to grow.

concept.heading: Creative concept
concept.body: We built the mark around the letter R, hiding a spark, the symbol of welding, in its negative space. The spark joins geometric shapes that stand for the solidity and precision of steel structures. The palette is led by blue, the color of a welding flame, complemented by raw metal greys that set the brand apart from red-and-orange competitors and build a sense of safety. It is all held together by the technical typeface TT Octosquares, whose square forms echo the world of steel construction.

results.heading: Result
results.body: We gave the guarding systems memorable, animal-inspired names: FALCON for lightweight mesh guards, RHINO for heavy-duty metal ones and GECKO for transparent polycarbonate. The communication strategy positions REM-MET as a leader that solves its audience's safety problems, while the new website presents the offer in a friendly way and guides customers effectively toward purchase.

quote.logo: A logo built around the letter R, with a welding spark hidden in its negative space.
quote.naming: FALCON, RHINO and GECKO: animal names that organize the range and stick in memory.

scope.heading: Project details

Promotional materials and advertising
Brand strategy and positioning
Naming of the product lines (FALCON, RHINO, GECKO)
Copywriting and verbal identity
Visual identity built on the spark motif
Technical TT Octosquares typography

ceramido.title: Ceramido
ceramido.intro: Ceramido was created in response to the growing needs of women 30+ who care about their health and skin, yet are looking for something more than an ordinary dietary supplement. The client wanted a brand that combines scientific efficacy with a luxury experience.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: Our task was to develop a modern visual identity and packaging designs that would set the supplement apart on the market and give it the character of a luxury object. The branding had to resonate with the tagline „Nature meets luxury”, drawing attention with its aesthetics while building trust through scientific precision.

challenge.heading: Challenge
challenge.body: Work on Ceramido's image began with an intensive, three-week sketching process. We explored different ways of combining the symbols that represent the brand's values, producing dozens of logo variants from which a single, coherent direction emerged.

concept.heading: Creative concept
concept.body: The logo is built on five symbols that capture the brand's scientific and luxurious character: the sun and moon stand for the day and night supplements, the crystal symbolizes luxury, the molecule underlines the science behind the product, and the skin structure points directly to its purpose. The palette is inspired by nature, by shades of white desert sand and black volcanic sand that symbolize dry skin and hydration as well as day and night, complemented by a skin tone and a soft grey. Geometric, modern typography harmonizes with the round shape of the logo, joining elegance with scientific precision.

results.heading: Result
results.body: We designed the packaging to protect the supplement from sunlight: metal jars in ivory for the DAY version and graphite for NIGHT. We enriched the minimalist label with a subtle pattern of skin molecules, joining function with elegance and setting the product apart on the market as natural, scientifically backed and luxurious.

quote.logo: A brand mark as a fusion of five symbols: sun, moon, crystal, molecule and skin structure.
quote.packaging: Minimalist metal packaging that protects the supplement and elevates it to luxury.

scope.heading: Project details
items: Logo design and rebrand
Product packaging (DAY and NIGHT versions)
Promotional materials
Brand strategy and positioning
Visual identity built on the symbolism of nature and science
Verbal identity and the tagline „Nature meets luxury”
Photo-shoot guidelines

italiana.title: Italiana
italiana.intro: Italiana is a pizzeria in Stalowa Wola that has been the local leader in serving pizza by the slice for years. Despite a great product, the brand communicated in an outdated way, looked ordinary and failed to stand out from the competition.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: Our task was to design a modern, minimalist and friendly identity that both families and young people would love. The brand had to become easily recognizable and unmistakably look like the leader of the local market.

challenge.heading: Challenge
challenge.body: The goal of the rebrand was to show how good Italiana's pizza is and to attract new customers. We chose a clear, modern style and consistent communication that highlight the quality of the product and build a lasting advantage over the competition.

concept.heading: Creative concept
concept.body: Italiana's mark is a refreshed, friendly wolf graphic, symbolizing the brand's Italian roots and its delicious, ravenous taste. The wolf appears in many moods and variants, tying all the materials together. We based the wordmark on the ARCO typeface, whose bold, rounded shapes bring energy and ease, paired with the simple, legible DM Sans. The palette is built on deep greens and warm white with strong contrast, energetic, appetizing and instantly associated with Italiana.

results.heading: Result
results.body: We built Italiana's personality around the Rebel archetype in a modern, cultured form: authenticity, instinct and independence. We tied the whole system together in a brandbook that lets the brand be run consistently across every touchpoint, from logo, color and typography to guidelines for social media, photography and the look of the venue, and even a ready prompt template for generating campaign images.

quote.wolf: The wolf as the brand mark: a symbol of Italian roots and a ravenous taste.
quote.rebel: Howl, Bite, Eat! A brand with the character of a Rebel.

scope.heading: Project details
items: Rebrand and logo design
Visual identity with the wolf motif
Brandbook with complete brand guidelines
Social media and photography guidelines
Typography (ARCO and DM Sans)
Graphic elements, stickers and icons
Brand applications: packaging, menu and venue materials

suseu.title: Suseu
suseu.intro: Suseu is an influencer-marketing platform that pulls creator discovery, campaigns, contracts and reporting into one app. We shaped its brand and designed the product across mobile and web.

description.heading: Project description
description.body: Suseu is a forward-thinking platform that merges influencer marketing, technology and everyday operations. The challenge was to build a brand and a product that feel bold, friendly and credible at once, turning a fragmented, compliance-heavy workflow into one clear, enjoyable tool. This project combined brand strategy, a distinctive visual identity and end-to-end product design for both mobile and web.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.body: Suseu needed an identity and a product that reflected its positioning: a new standard in influencer marketing, approachable yet professional. Before Suseu, brands relied on fragmented tools: social searches, manual outreach and expensive databases that were slow, inconsistent and opaque. The category felt corporate and cold, while the people using it are young, fast-moving and creative. The key was to balance personality with clarity, so a tool full of legal and operational complexity still felt simple to use on every screen, from a quick TikTok deal to an agency running many campaigns at once.

designProcess.heading: Design Process
designProcess.body: On the product side we ran the full UX process, research, ideation, prototyping, testing and iteration, for both the mobile app and the web platform. Each had its own user flows and information architecture, but they shared one design system, so the experience stayed consistent from a phone in a creator's hand to a dashboard on a marketer's screen.

strategicFoundation.heading: Strategic Foundation
strategicFoundation.body: We started by dissecting Suseu's core values and defining its personality. The brand's DNA revolves around freeing teams from busywork so they can focus on strategy and creativity. The research phase covered competitor analysis (with Useme.com and Fiverr.com as the key references), target audiences and two core personas: Kuba, a 23-year-old TikTok creator who wants every collaboration in one place, and Anna, a 30-year-old marketing manager who needs clear, fast reporting. Their goals and pain points shaped every later decision.

typography.heading: Typography
typography.body: Typography leads the system. We chose Poppins, a modern, geometric typeface whose clean lines and high legibility keep the interface clear and contemporary. Its rounded, friendly shapes soften a data-dense product, while a clear hierarchy of regular and bold weights keeps dashboards, reports and long flows easy to scan.

colorPalette.heading: Color Palette
colorPalette.body: The palette is built on a confident pink and purple, balanced with deep near-black surfaces and neutral grays. The vivid pink is the brand's signature, drawing attention to key actions and carrying the Pink Gopher Influencer across the product, while the dark UI keeps long working sessions calm and focused. High contrast ensures clarity and recognition across every application.

applications.heading: Applications and Mockups
applications.body: The identity flexes across every brand touchpoint, from onboarding and empty states to the landing page, social media and marketing materials. The Pink Gopher Influencer shows up wherever it adds warmth, while the system holds a consistent look in mockups across merch, decks and digital. Everything stays recognizably Suseu, whatever the surface.

mobileApp.heading: Mobile App
mobileApp.body: The mobile app is built for creators like Kuba: a simple, fast way to keep every collaboration in one place. We led with a clear dashboard and a single, always-reachable action through a floating button, so accepting a deal, signing a contract or checking a message never takes more than a tap. The interface speaks the user's language and strips away the formality that made influencer deals feel like paperwork.

webPlatform.heading: Web Platform
webPlatform.body: The web platform is the brand's control center, designed for managers like Anna. It brings creator search across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, automated UOKiK-compliant contracts, a built-in chat, reporting and a PR zone into one workspace. We opened the build with a functional requirements document that captured every need up front and kept the scope, around 180 views, under control, then designed the deeper analytics and views the mobile app intentionally leaves out.

testing.heading: Testing and Iteration
testing.body: We validated decisions with usability and A/B testing and refined the flows before handoff, working closely with Suseu's founder and developer throughout. The lesson we carried out: more low-fidelity testing earlier saves time later, and design is never truly 'done', the strongest improvements arrive once real users are in the product after launch.

results.heading: Results and Learnings
results.body: Suseu launched with a coherent identity and a product that turns scattered, manual work into a single source of truth. The combination of a friendly brand hero and a clear, dark, data-ready interface made a dense, compliance-driven category feel like something people actually want to use. Brand and product reinforce each other at every touchpoint: the same personality that makes the logo memorable makes the app approachable, proving that strategy, identity and UX work best when they are designed as one system.

quote.brand: A pink gopher glued to its phone: the brand hero that makes a serious martech tool feel human.
quote.product: From weeks to minutes: find a creator, sign the contract, run the campaign, all in one place.

header.intro: These terms set out how ENTEI services are ordered and paid for online, how they are delivered, and how to withdraw from a contract or file a complaint. The Polish version is binding.

sections.title: §1. General provisions
paragraphs: These terms are issued under art. 8 of the Polish Act of 18 July 2002 on providing services by electronic means. They apply to services ordered via www.entei.design (including agency.entei.pl).

The service provider and seller is ENTEI Sebastian Jarmul, ul. Wojska Polskiego 24/13, 37-450 Stalowa Wola, Poland, VAT ID (NIP) 8652574151, registered in the Central Register and Information on Economic Activity (CEIDG), hereinafter “ENTEI”.
Definitions:
bullets: Client: a natural or legal person or organisational unit placing an Order.
Consumer: a Client who is a natural person concluding a contract not directly related to their business or profession.

Sole trader with consumer rights: a natural person running a sole proprietorship for whom the contract is not of a professional nature (art. 38a of the Consumer Rights Act). They have the same withdrawal rights as a Consumer.
Service: a service from ENTEI's offer described on the order page.
Order: the Client's declaration made through the order form, aimed at concluding a service contract.

sections.title: §2. Seller details and contact
paragraphs: ENTEI Sebastian Jarmul, ul. Wojska Polskiego 24/13, 37-450 Stalowa Wola, Poland, VAT ID (NIP) 8652574151. REGON 544272533. Registered in CEIDG.
Email (also for complaints and withdrawal): hello@entei.design.
Phone: +48 791 912 845, standard operator rates.
Postal address for correspondence and complaints: ul. Wojska Polskiego 24/13, 37-450 Stalowa Wola, Poland.

sections.title: §3. Services and prices
paragraphs: The description, scope, price and duration of each Service are shown on the order page before the Order is placed. We offer:
bullets: Qualified leads (Meta Ads campaigns): 90-day cycle, PLN 3,000 net (PLN 3,690 gross) per month, PLN 11,070 gross per cycle in total. Month 1 is paid online when ordering, months 2 and 3 by VAT invoice payable within 7 days.
Branding Package: PLN 5,000 net (PLN 6,150 gross), one-off online payment when ordering.

sections.title: §4. Placing an order and concluding the contract
paragraphs: To order, the Client picks a Service in the pricing section, fills in the form (name, email, phone and, for a company invoice, company details and VAT ID), accepts these terms and clicks “Order and pay”, which entails an obligation to pay.
The contract is concluded once PayU records the payment. We email a confirmation of the contract with a link to these terms (durable medium).
Technical requirements: a device with internet access, an up-to-date browser and an active email address.

sections.title: §5. Payments
paragraphs: Prices are in Polish zloty and include 23% VAT (gross). The net amount is shown alongside.

Online payments are handled by PayU S.A., Poznań (ul. Grunwaldzka 186, 60-166 Poznań), a national payment institution supervised by the Polish Financial Supervision Authority. Available methods: BLIK, instant bank transfer (pay-by-link), Visa and Mastercard cards and other methods shown on the PayU page.
Online payment is required when placing the Order (in advance). Further billing periods of a recurring Service are paid by bank transfer against a VAT invoice within 7 days of issue.
We charge no surcharge for any payment method. We issue a VAT invoice on request and send it by email.
Refunds are made using the same payment method, unless the Client agrees to another one at no extra cost.

sections.title: §6. Service delivery
paragraphs: Services are provided remotely (online). We ship no physical goods, so there are no delivery costs. Deliverables (e.g. design files, reports) are provided electronically.
Within 3 business days of payment we contact the Client to book a kick-off meeting.

Meta Ads campaigns: the first campaigns go live within 14 days of the kick-off meeting, provided the Client grants access to their Meta ad account. The Client pays the ad budget directly to Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd.; it is not part of the Service price.

Branding Package: delivery within 30 business days of the kick-off meeting, 2 rounds of revisions included. Economic copyrights to the accepted design pass to the Client upon acceptance and full payment.
The Client cooperates with ENTEI as needed to deliver the Service (access, materials, feedback). Delays on the Client's side extend deadlines accordingly.

sections.title: §7. Duration and termination
paragraphs: The “Qualified leads” contract is concluded for a fixed term of 90 days (the Client's minimum commitment). It expires at the end of the cycle. Renewal requires a new Order.
The Branding Package contract expires upon acceptance of the design.
Either party may terminate the contract with immediate effect if the other party materially breaches it and fails to remedy the breach within 7 days of being notified.

sections.title: §8. Withdrawal from the contract
paragraphs: A Consumer and a sole trader with consumer rights may withdraw from the contract without giving a reason within 14 days of its conclusion by sending a statement by email to hello@entei.design or by post to the address in §2 before the deadline. The model form from annex 2 to the Consumer Rights Act may be used. We confirm receipt by email.
If the Client requested that the Service start before the withdrawal period ends and then withdraws, they pay for the part performed until withdrawal, in proportion to the scope of the contract.

The right of withdrawal does not apply once ENTEI has fully performed the Service with the Client's express consent, given after being informed that they would lose the right of withdrawal upon full performance (art. 38(1)(1) of the Consumer Rights Act).
We refund payments within 14 days of receiving the withdrawal statement, using the same payment method (see §5).
This right of withdrawal does not apply to Clients contracting in a professional capacity.

sections.title: §9. Complaints
paragraphs: ENTEI must provide Services in accordance with the contract. Complaints can be filed by email to hello@entei.design or by post to the address in §2.
A complaint should include the Client's details, the order number, a description of the problem and the expected resolution (e.g. revision, re-performance, price reduction or refund).
We respond within 14 days of receipt, by email, and keep the Client informed of progress.

sections.title: §10. Personal data
paragraphs: ENTEI is the controller of Clients' personal data. We process data under the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) to conclude and perform the contract, issue invoices and handle complaints. Details, including the Client's rights, are in the Privacy Policy.
To process payments we share the Client's data (name, email, phone, amount) with PayU S.A., which is a separate controller for payment processing.
Data is protected, among others, by an encrypted connection (HTTPS). We do not store payment card data.

sections.title: §11. Order restrictions
paragraphs: We serve Clients based or resident in Poland; settlement in PLN only.
Orders may be placed by adults with full legal capacity.
Meta Ads campaigns require a Meta Business account and a business permitted by Meta's advertising policies. We do not run campaigns for industries prohibited by those policies.

sections.title: §12. Code of good practice
paragraphs: We act fairly and transparently: we show full prices before ordering, charge no hidden fees, reply to messages within 1 business day and inform you of any change to deadlines.

sections.title: §13. Dispute resolution
paragraphs: Consumers may use out-of-court complaint and redress procedures, including municipal or district consumer ombudsmen and permanent consumer arbitration courts at the Provincial Trade Inspectorates. More at www.uokik.gov.pl.

sections.title: §14. Final provisions
paragraphs: Matters not covered here are governed by Polish law, in particular the Civil Code and the Consumer Rights Act.
Amendments do not affect contracts concluded before they take effect.
These terms are available free of charge at www.entei.design/regulamin in a form that can be downloaded and printed.
